fsSection.title: FORMULA STUDENT
fsSection.description: Algorithm competitions test not only programming skills but also engineering knowledge and problem-solving abilities. Participants are divided into different categories based on their experience level and programming languages. Competitions include various challenges such as data structures, algorithms, and system design. Teams are evaluated based on code quality, efficiency, and innovation. The scoring methods vary across different competition platforms.

teamSection.title: TEAM
teamSection.subtitle: TOGETHER WE CAN DO ANYTHING
teamSection.description: Young, ambitious, committed, and brave—these words best describe the members of Yuanjing Team. Our organization operates with a structure similar to major companies. The team is led by a team leader who bears the greatest responsibility. The technical director reports directly to them, managing department heads across all areas except marketing—which reports directly to the team leader. Each team member reports to their respective department head.

historySection.title: TEAM HISTORY
historySection.subtitle: HISTORY OF OUR TEAM
historySection.description: Students passionate about computer science have always been among the most talented, with exceptional desire for knowledge and experience. To meet the needs of young developers and project managers, Yuanjing Team was founded in 2018. Each year, we develop new innovative software projects. We have 15+ campus projects to our credit, each showcasing advanced technology and practical applications. Our team members have achieved recognition in programming competitions like the Blue Bridge Cup. Since establishment, we've been committed to technical excellence and continuous learning in software development.

footer.seasonDescription: Yuanjing team, founded in 2018, unites computer enthusiasts across all majors. We practice Go/Python/Java, web development, and algorithm competitions. With 15+ campus projects and "Blue Bridge Cup" awards, every line of code creates value.

navAbout.paragraph1: Yuanjing Team is a student software development organization focused on innovative technology research and practical application. Since 2018, our team has brought together computer enthusiasts from various majors to explore cutting-edge programming technologies and participate in prestigious competitions. Our greatest achievements include completing 15+ campus projects and winning awards in algorithm competitions like the Blue Bridge Cup.
navAbout.paragraph2: Throughout its activity, the Team has developed numerous software projects, earning recognition in programming competitions across the region. Following the rapid evolution of technology, Yuanjing Team embraces new challenges in areas like artificial intelligence, web development, and mobile applications. Team members quickly adapt to emerging technologies and frameworks. We've successfully implemented various innovative solutions in campus management systems, intelligent companions, and tracking systems. Currently, the Team is working on next-generation projects incorporating modern architectures.
navAbout.paragraph3: Designing and developing comprehensive software systems is an advanced, interdisciplinary project that allows young developers and managers to grow. It requires enormous commitment from the Team, translating to thousands of hours that members spend coding, designing, and implementing solutions. The success of our projects is possible thanks to the support of our university, local technology companies, and various industry partners who provide guidance and resources.

garage.title: Garage
garage.paragraph: At our campus laboratory in Xinxiang, you will find our development spaces where we work on software projects with passion and commitment. These modern facilities are our zone of creativity and innovation, where Yuanjing Team tackles new programming challenges every day. Each workspace is tailored to the specific needs of our departments, providing optimal conditions for frontend development, backend architecture, mobile applications, and algorithm research. This space not only fosters technological development but also serves as a place for team collaboration, knowledge sharing, and problem-solving.

departmentsAbout.title: OUR DEPARTMENTS
departmentsAbout.interestedIn: WHICH DEPARTMENT ARE YOU INTERESTED IN?

frontend.description: The department is responsible for designing and building the suspension system. It is also responsible for the elements of the autonomous steering and braking systems, mounting parts, and metal structures in the monocoque.

responsibilities.text: designing and building the suspension system
designing and building elements of the autonomous steering system
designing and building the braking system
designing mounting parts and metal structures in the monocoque

backend.description: The department is responsible for backend development, server architecture, and database management. From designing scalable microservices architecture to implementing robust APIs, ensuring data security and system performance optimization.

responsibilities.text: modeling composite elements in CAD programs
strength simulations and optimization of composite structures
CFD simulations of the aerodynamic package
production and strength testing of composite elements

product.description: The department is responsible for product management, user experience design, and project coordination. From analyzing requirements and creating prototypes to managing product lifecycle and organizing team events, including preparation for algorithm competitions.

responsibilities.text: creating promotional materials
preparing algorithm presentations
coordinating orders, data analysis, optimizing Team's work
organizing events

design.description: The department is responsible for algorithm research, artificial intelligence development, and advanced programming solutions. From developing machine learning models to implementing efficient algorithms for data processing, natural language processing, and computer vision. Projects are developed using programming languages such as Python, C++, and Java.

responsibilities.text: developing algorithms that improve autonomous driving
developing embedded systems

operates.description: The department is responsible for designing PCBs, creating high and low voltage harnesses, and building a custom high-voltage battery.

responsibilities.text: designing and manufacturing PCBs
designing in CAD programs and manufacturing high and low voltage harnesses compliant with motorsport standards
modeling housings for electronics in CAD programs
designing and manufacturing high-voltage batteries
thermal simulations of electronics and batteries
designing CAN bus

mobile.description: The department is responsible for maximizing mobile, vehicle kinematics and dynamics, data acquisition, powertrain, and test organization.

responsibilities.text: Vehicle dynamics simulations
Designing and developing the powertrain
Analyzing data from runs

algorithm.description: Department responsible for team operations, content creation, and social media management. Including partnership coordination, team promotion, and preparation for programming competitions and technical presentations.

responsibilities.text: Coordination of orders, data analysis, optimization of the Team's work
Preparation of algorithm presentations
Contact with partners

acceleration.title: Acceleration
acceleration.text: A programming challenge that involves solving algorithm problems as efficiently as possible, assessing code optimization and problem-solving speed. Teams have multiple attempts, and the best solution is evaluated.

skidPad.title: Skid Pad
skidPad.text: A competition involving driving in a “figure-eight” pattern. Each team has two attempts, and the better one is considered for scoring.

autocross.title: Autocross
autocross.text: A competition where participants aim to complete one lap of the track in the shortest time possible. Two drivers from each team can participate, each having two runs. The best time from the four runs is considered.

endurance.title: Endurance
endurance.text: A competition involving a race of about 22 kilometers. After 11 kilometers, there is a driver change, which the team has 3 minutes to complete. This is the highest-scoring competition, but only teams that finish the race receive points.

cost.title: Cost and Manufacturing
cost.text: A competition that evaluates project planning accuracy and team members' knowledge of software development costs, resource allocation, and technology stack selection.

engineering.title: Engineering Design
engineering.text: A competition involving the presentation of software architecture and system design. Judges assess the technical skills and creativity of team members in designing both the overall system and individual components. This is the highest-scoring presentation competition, judged by software industry experts.

algorithm.title: algorithm Plan Presentation
algorithm.text: A competition where team members take on the role of a start-up board, for example, creating custom brake systems. Using a ten-minute presentation, they must convince judges acting as investors to support their algorithm model.

faqItems.question: How to join yuanjing Team?
faqItems.answer: Please visit our 'Join Us' page for the latest recruitment information, or contact our team leaders directly.

faqItems.question: How to become a partner?
faqItems.answer: Please contact our partnership coordinator. We are happy to discuss collaboration opportunities.

faqItems.question: Can we visit the lab?
faqItems.answer: Yes! Please contact us in advance to schedule a visit.

faqItems.question: What technical background is required?
faqItems.answer: We welcome students of all technical levels! From beginners to experienced developers, everyone can find suitable projects and learning paths.
